charter: Three painted embossed monochrome naval designer glyphs in bronze/silver/gold, with distinct structural subjects. Symbolic wooden construction fragments, not literal metal hulls or certified construction plans.
prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE tiny Victoria 3 ship-designer wooden GALLEY HULL equipment UI icon.
Input image 1: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match native simplified painted embossed glyphs, thin dark beveled outline, broad material shading, not photorealistic rendering or architectural plans.
Primary request: a compact isolated schematic wooden hull/structural fragment. The structural improvement MUST dominate the silhouette, not the same drawing with more little planks. Readable at 32px even in grayscale. Consistent three-quarter view slightly from above, both top and interior structure visible. Few strong geometric forms. Only the essential timber members.
One monochrome metallic tier applies to ALL parts, including wood grain; not a literal iron hull. Genuine transparent background, empty gaps, solid opaque object interiors. Center with margins; complete glyph inside canvas. No surrounding glow, bloom, haze, aura, scenic cast shadow or background.
Avoid: complete ship, masts, sails, oars, weapons, engines, screw propeller, people, text, labels, badges, shields, rivet clutter, ropes, dramatic backdrop or tiny detailed construction plan.
LOW tier: warm copper BRONZE. A LIGHT shallow curved hull-shell cross-section fragment, just THREE broad smooth edge-to-edge planks on the outer sides, with TWO slim curved ribs inside. Low open bowl-like silhouette, no top crossbeam, no central keelson, no extra reinforcement. Show lightweight simple smooth carvel planking, not overlapping clinker scales. Simple spare compact U-shaped piece with much open interior.

qa.visual_inspection: Full-size and 180/64/32px comparison inspected. Bronze open hull-shell fragment with sparse ribs; silver hull with three large bridging transverse beams and side longitudinal timbers; gold elongated central spine and ribs with projecting layered ends. Main distinguishing forms survive thumbnail reduction, fine construction joins do not. Drawings are stylized symbols, not exact section plans. Gold contains a visible exterior glow despite no-halo prompt; retained as generated. Bronze/silver/gold contain genuine transparent blank pixels and mostly partial-alpha artwork; no opacity or artistic retouch applied.

integration_note: Approved exact raw masters copied into tracked source pack and installed as three 120px DDS with seven mipmaps. Only aor_galley_armor_low/mid/high icon bindings changed. Existing stat modifiers, costs, technology gates and starting fleets preserved. No in-game test.
